main.summary: Coordinates stream transfer session operations with append-oriented staged DataServices storage.

method.name: OpenStreamTransfer
method.summary: Open a new stream source transfer session.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial source session state.

method.name: OpenFollowStreamTransfer
method.summary: Open a new stream follower session over an existing source transfer.
method.returns: Open response containing the initial follower session state.

method.name: ReOpenStreamTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing stream source transfer session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current source session state.

method.name: ReOpenFollowStreamTransfer
method.summary: Reattach to an existing stream follower session.
method.returns: Reopen response containing the current follower session state.

method.name: GetStreamTransferState
method.summary: Get the current transfer state for a staged stream transfer session.

method.name: PutStreamTransferSegment
method.summary: Validate and append a stream payload segment at the current durable tail of an existing source session.
method.param: Readable segment payload stream positioned at the first byte to append.

method.name: GetStreamTransferSegment
method.summary: Read a realized stream payload segment from an existing source or follower session.
method.returns: Segment footer metadata plus a readable payload stream.

method.name: BeginCompleteStreamTransfer
method.summary: Validate a stream completion request, freeze the source session in the committing state, and persist the finalized local completion artifacts needed for later publish.
method.returns: Response containing the frozen local completion state prepared for publish.

method.name: CancelCompleteStreamTransfer
method.summary: Cancel a previously begun stream completion attempt and restore the retained source session to a retryable stream-upload state.
method.param: Transfer identity for the retained source session.
method.returns: Updated stream transfer state after the completion attempt has been cancelled.

method.name: FinishCompleteStreamTransfer
method.summary: Finalize a previously begun stream completion after external publish has succeeded.
method.param: Transfer identity for the retained source session.
method.returns: Final completion response for the retained stream session.

method.name: GetSessions
method.summary: Enumerate retained stream transfer sessions that match the optional filters.

method.name: AbortTransfer
method.summary: Abort a staged stream transfer session and delete its staged artifacts.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove retained stream transfer session artifacts.

method.name: SessionExists
method.summary: Determine whether a retained stream transfer session exists for the supplied identity.
method.returns: True when the stream session exists and matches the supplied item.
